escalation.evidence: Payments log: "rejected charge: API token has been revoked by the account owner". Shop log: "payment rejected (HTTP 401): token_revoked ... A new token must be issued from the provider dashboard". Smoke test checkout returns 502 with upstream_status 401. The other 4 checks pass: health, catalog, latency and stats_integrity. Both services are running.
escalation.actions_taken: Diagnosis only. I changed nothing. I did not guess or fabricate a token. Restarting won't help because the token itself is revoked.
escalation.recommended_next_step: Issue a new API token from the payments provider dashboard. Put it in PAYMENTS_TOKEN in .env, restart the shop service, then run the smoke tests to confirm checkout returns 201. Also confirm with the account owner why the token was revoked.
